This is based on the project docs only. I didn't open any source files, so line numbers come from the doc anchors and may have drifted. Nothing was modified.

## Worker (`worker/`)

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `src/types/index.ts` | Add `RestBody { sessionId: string; characterId: string }` near the other `*Body` types (`LevelUpBody:168` is the closest model). Add a cost constant such as `INN_REST_COST`. The cost can be flat (e.g. 10 gold) or scale with level. It lives here because the Worker owns the rules. |
| `src/routes/rest.ts` (new) | Export `restRoutes = new Hono<{ Bindings: Env }>()` with `POST /`. Steps: validate the body (400), `getCharacter` (404), reject with 400 if `gold < cost`, reject if `hp >= max_hp` so no gold is wasted, and reject if the character is in combat. The combat check is an open question: `CombatState` lives in the KV session, so the route needs `loadSession` for it. Then call `updateCharacter(db, id, { hp: max_hp, gold: gold - cost })` (`services/character.ts:94`, whitelisted fields only). Optionally call `askDM` for narration. Then `appendHistory`, `saveSession`, and an `adventure_log` insert, following `routes/action.ts` and `routes/levelup.ts`. Return `{ narrative, updatedCharacter, cost }`. |
| `src/index.ts` (`:41-48`) | Import `restRoutes` and add `app.route('/api/rest', restRoutes)`. No CORS change is needed. |
| `src/services/character.ts` | No change needed. `updateCharacter` already accepts `hp` and `gold`. Only add a helper (e.g. `restAtInn`) if you want the logic outside the route. |
| `migrations/` | No change. `hp`, `max_hp`, and `gold` already exist, so the schema is untouched. |

## Frontend (`frontend/src/app/`)

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `models/game.models.ts` | Add a `RestResponse` interface (`narrative`, `updatedCharacter: Character`, `cost`). Add the cost constant too if the UI shows the price. Nothing enforces that this mirrors the Worker types, so keep them in step by hand. |
| `services/game-api.service.ts` | Add `rest(sessionId, characterId)` that posts to `${API_BASE}/api/rest`, in the style of `levelUp():74`. |
| `components/game-console/game-console.component.ts` | Add a `rest()` handler (modelled on `levelUp():183`). It calls `api.rest`, then `CharacterStateService.setCharacter(res.updatedCharacter)`, then pushes the narrative as a console entry. On error, show `err.error.error` (for example "not enough gold"). Disable it while `inCombat()`. |
| `components/game-console/game-console.component.html` | Add a "Rest at Inn (N gold)" button in the left column next to the Inventory button (`:9`). Disable it when `inCombat`, when gold is below the cost, or when HP is already full. |
| `components/game-console/game-console.component.css` | Add styling for the new button, only if needed. |
| `components/game-console/game-console.component.spec.ts` | Add tests with `GameApiService` as a Jasmine spy: the success path updates the character, and the error path shows a message. The current spec doesn't cover actions, combat, or level-up. |
| `services/character-state.service.ts` | No change needed. `setCharacter` already updates HP and gold. |

## Docs to update in the same change

- The doc beside each changed file, plus the new `docs/code/worker/src/routes/rest.md`.
- The `code.md` entry and symbol index, rebuilt with `research-work/scripts/build-symbol-index.mjs`.
- `docs/PRD.md` §9 (API spec).
- The route-mounts table in `docs/code/worker/src/index.md`.
- `docs/flows/inventory.md`, or a new flow doc, plus a routing-table row in `AGENTS.md`.

## Caveats

- Combat HP is also held in the KV session. Check whether `CombatState` or the session caches player HP. If it does, update it, or block resting during combat.
- B-10: death leaves HP at 0 with input still enabled. Resting at the inn would work as a revive, so decide whether you want that.
